title: Juicy Fresh British Asparagus Skillet
description: A fresh and crisp British dish featuring asparagus, perfect for a brunch mood, and friendly to dairy-free diets. This skillet is made with brine-wet asparagus and other tasty ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the asparagus to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, or until slightly tender.
Sprinkle the salt, black pepper, and garlic powder over the asparagus and stir to combine.
Pour in the lemon juice and water, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes, or until the asparagus is tender.
Stir in the vegan butter until melted and well combined.
Serve the asparagus hot, garnished with lemon wedges if desired.
Let it rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
